notes.title: Many changes, plus FISHING!
notes.notes:
After copious requests from the playerbase, (actually 1 person saying it might be fun) Prismatic now has fishing!!
-Catch fish in 3 worlds and earn credits and experience
-Several rarities and sizes of fish
-If you bought Ember or Sophia skins in the ship, you can play and earn XP with them too!
-Dynamic reeling-in time to simulate fish weight

But wait, there's more. Some of the other changes:
-A dialogue fix
-Settings/tutorial teleporting you fix
-Enemy pathfinding improvement 
-Combat balancing
